changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleResultFusionAttribute') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultFusionAttribute]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [RuleResultID] [int] NOT NULL, [FusionAttribute] [nvarchar](2500) NOT NULL, [FusionAttributeID] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_RuleResultFusionAttribute] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleResultFusionAttribute_RuleResult') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultFusionAttribute] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResultFusionAttribute_RuleResult] FOREIGN KEY([RuleResultID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[RuleResult] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultFusionAttribute] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResultFusionAttribute_RuleResult] END
